label: VERIFIED
extraction: Idemeum Endpoint Care Guardrails: 4 gates every request must pass, none skippable by model. Gate 1 - Intent screening: rejects off-topic, jailbreak attempts, smuggled instructions. Gate 2 - Plan validation: agent produces ordered plan validated against matched skill (allowed tools, diagnostics before fixes). Gate 3 - Policy evaluation: checks approved plan against central policy (admin approval, forbidden actions, per-user rules). Gate 4 - Execution gates: deterministic execution via code-reviewed tools only, AI never writes commands/scripts, audit every step. 5 security properties: plan as whitelist, AI never writes running code, consent as mechanism not courtesy, least privilege real boundaries.
